TEXT.English: Hiram I is associated with early first-millennium BCE Tyre and traditions of timber, craft exchange and royal diplomacy. Exact chronology and associations with David and Solomon rely heavily on later textual traditions. He is not credited here with founding later Carthage. The city list spans Phoenician coastal settlements for gameplay and does not claim that every settlement belonged to his kingdom. The merchant ship and counting house abstract maritime exchange rather than reproducing a documented named regiment or identical civic building.
